transcript: I want you to look at the login screen because when the password field is empty the submit button still works and it sends a request anyway can you make it disabled until both fields have text and then add a test that checks the button state for that case

the build is failing on the release branch and I think it is the new linter rule we added last week could you check the config file and see if the rule about unused imports is set to error instead of warning and if so change it back to warning

can you refactor the payment service so that the retry logic lives in its own class right now it is mixed in with the request code and it is hard to test I want three retries with a backoff of two seconds and no retries at all for validation errors

so the dashboard takes about eight seconds to load and most of that is the reports query I think we are loading every row and filtering in the app instead of in the database can you move the date filter into the query and add an index on created at

uh so let's add a dark mode toggle to the settings page it should follow the system setting by default and remember the choice in user defaults also make sure the chart colors still have enough contrast in dark mode because last time the grid lines were almost invisible there

I need a script that goes through the logs folder and deletes files older than thirty days but only the ones ending in dot log not the archives it should print what it deletes and have a dry run flag so I can check it first before it removes anything

you know the upload component it fails silently when the file is bigger than ten megabytes can you show an error message under the drop area instead and tell the user the limit the progress bar keeps going after a failure which is confusing so stop it when that happens

write unit tests for the date parser it should handle ISO dates with and without time zones and the short format we get from the old API like day month year with slashes and it should return nil for empty strings rather than throwing an error like it does today

the notification emails go out twice for some users I think the job runs on both servers after the deploy last Tuesday can you add a lock around the send step using the database table we already have for the cron jobs and log a warning when it skips one

hmm um can you explain why the memory usage keeps growing when the app sits idle I took a heap snapshot and there are thousands of timer objects maybe something is not cancelling them when the view closes look at the polling code in the status bar controller first please
